What if you could regrow body parts like an axolotl?
Meet the axolotl. About 23 centimeters long.
Lose a leg? It grows a new one.
Bone, muscle, nerves. All of it.
Within a day, skin seals the wound.
Then a bud of cells appears. A blastema.
The bud grows into a perfect leg.
Weeks later, it's fully back. No scar.
It even repairs its heart and spinal cord.
Now you. Humans can regrow a little.
Your liver can regrow most of itself.
Young kids can regrow a fingertip.
But a whole arm? No. Just a scar.
A glowing bud sprouts from your shoulder.
And grows... a brand new arm!
So... what would you regrow first?
